declared_at_utc: see commit (7 October 2026, before the governing run)
declared_by: Declaring and the governing run are research; a build under runs/submissions and any upload stay the user's word.
status: DECLARED before its governing run. August, September and October 2025 have not been read for this extension.
disclosure: Exploration on the four development months, on top of nbr_state_v1 w75's development values (docs/quick_screens/README.md): dark rows (ADS-B matched, pushback not traced) as focal rows with per-airport slopes w0.5 / 0.75 (eq -0.0198 / -0.0231%, July's interval above zero), gate-only neighbours (eq -0.008..-0.010%), second terms on unmatched rows (300 / 3,600 s windows, gate-only neighbours: eq -0.002..-0.008%), month-blocked LightGBM over neighbour summaries on all / unmatched+dark / dark rows (eq -0.016..-0.038%, July's interval above zero in every variant), y clipped at 900 s, a 1,800 s window, a 60 s cap, and ONE slope pooled over all airports (w0.5 eq -0.0161%; w0.75 Jan -0.0055 / Jul -0.0167 / Nov -0.0346 / Dec -0.0387%, eq -0.0203%, every interval below zero). The declared candidate is the last; it was chosen after these reads and passes clause 2 by 0.0003 points. Clauses 1-3 are therefore NOT a clean test; clause 4 (three months never read for this extension) is the clean test and is binding. Ranking transfer ratios were computed in exploration (label-free): 0.77-1.28 at every airport.
mechanism: As nbr_state_v1, extended to dark rows: ADS-B saw the aircraft but not its pushback, so the chain's value carries only part of the ground state. Their residual follows the same day-demeaned mean of (value - v9) over matched neighbours within 900 s (the row itself excluded), with one slope for all airports.

procedure.base: nbr_state_v1 w75 applied first, exactly as tools/run_nbr_state.py (development: month-blocked per-airport slopes; fresh: development slopes on rows12 'stack'; ranking: the v71 dry run runs/nbr_state/rank/dry_v71/vigorous-whistle_v71.parquet, SHA-256 7a0b1431eef1146d7afd40c728bea7af6b90a411e257ca277564866e410b84ed).
procedure.x: tools/run_nbr_state.state, unchanged (matched flag and v9 as nbr_state_v1).
procedure.dark_rows: matched rows (the base predictor's ADS-B routing, as nbr_state_v1) that are NOT gate-traced (gate True in data/external/adsblol/matches/matches2_<month>.parquet), with x defined; LIRF population rows (development cls LIRF_pop; fresh the raw rule of run_nbr_state
procedure.slope: B = sum(x * y) / sum(x^2) over dark rows of the fitting months, ONE slope for all airports, y = clip(label - base, -1800, 1800). Development: each month fitted on the other three. Fresh and ranking: all four development months.
procedure.value: new = max(base + clip(w * B * x, -120, 120), -12) on dark rows, applied after nbr_state_v1. Ranking: np.rint into the file's dtype; every other row byte-identical to the v71 dry run.

rule.control: nbr_state_v1 w75's values (development, fresh and ranking).
rule.clause_1: No development month (January, July, November, December 2025) worse than the control by more than 0.005% of complete-month RMSE.
rule.clause_2: Equal-footing mean (January, July, December) at most -0.02%.
rule.clause_3: Paired-day 95% interval below zero for January, July and December (tools/run_intruder_bound.interval, 2,000 replicates, seed 20261004).
rule.clause_4_fresh: BINDING clean test, August / September / October 2025 against the control on rows12: every month better and at least two of the three paired-day intervals strictly below zero.
rule.clause_5_transfer: Per airport, RMS of the ranking change (both months pooled, dark rows) within 0.5x-2x of the RMS of the out-of-month development change on dark rows; an airport outside keeps the control on every row.
rule.selection: dark_pool_w75 if clauses 1-4 pass; otherwise the control (nbr_state_v1 w75) stays.
rule.scoring: Every row of every complete month, all labels.
